title: League pilot: 12 stages, the League road and three mastery trophies
problem: The League has six stages of six days, all won the same way; there is no visible climb or mastery trophy.
scope: Engine stage options (League only): starting cash and stock, starting day and phase, 1 to 6 days, rule parts on or off, rival habits, goals beyond winning
Chapter 1 Village Square: the six current stages plus six new ones (read the rival, sell before it spoils, time the mangoes, bid on a contract, rescue the stall, a four-stall finale)
3 stars a stage (clear plus 2 optional goals); earned stars kept
League road: next stage, best stars, next trophy, expert stages opened by stars; results name the missed goal with Retry
Mastery trophies Contract Trader, Night Market Regular and Market Reader with a title and an existing Wardrobe item
exclusions: No rule change; ordinary games' stamps unchanged; chapters open by League clears, not stall level
